general.title: MOSuite - Plot Venn Diagram
general.instructions: Create Venn diagram or Intersection plot visualizations of differential expression results across multiple contrasts

parameters.name: Contrasts column name
parameters.description: Name of the column in the summarized differential expression data that contains the contrast names.

parameters.name: Select contrasts
parameters.description: A vector of contrast names to select for the plot.

parameters.name: Plot type
parameters.description: Type of plot to generate: Venn diagram or Intersection plot.

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: The column from the counts data containing the Feature IDs, usually Gene or Protein ID. This is usually the first column of the input counts matrix. Only columns of text type from the input counts matrix are available to select for this parameter.

parameters.name: Intersection IDs
parameters.description: A vector of intersection IDs to select for the plot.

parameters.name: Force unique elements
parameters.description: If TRUE, forces unique elements in the Venn diagram.

parameters.name: Venn numbers format
parameters.description: Format for the numbers in the Venn diagram. Options are raw, percent, raw-percent, or percent-raw.

parameters.name: Venn significant digits
parameters.description: Number of significant digits for the Venn diagram numbers.

parameters.name: Category names distance
parameters.description: Distance of the category names from the Venn diagram circles.

parameters.name: Category names position
parameters.description: Position of the category names in the Venn diagram.

parameters.name: Intersections order
parameters.description: Order of the intersections in the plot.

parameters.name: Display empty intersections
parameters.description: If TRUE, displays intersections with no features in the plot.

parameters.name: Table content
parameters.description: Content of the table in the plot.

parameters.name: Venn fill colors
parameters.description: A vector of colors to fill the Venn diagram categories.

parameters.name: Venn fill transparency
parameters.description: Transparency level for the Venn diagram fill colors.

parameters.name: Venn border colors
parameters.description: Colors for the borders of the Venn diagram categories. Use fill colors to match venn_fill_colors, or specify color names.

parameters.name: Category names font size
parameters.description: Font size for the category names in the Venn diagram.

parameters.name: Counts font size
parameters.description: Font size for the counts in the Venn diagram.

parameters.name: Outer margin
parameters.description: Outer margin for the Venn diagram.

parameters.name: Intersection bar color
parameters.description: Color for the intersection bars in the plot

parameters.name: Intersection point size
parameters.description: Size of the points in the intersection plot.

parameters.name: Intersection line width
parameters.description: Width of the lines in the intersection plot.

parameters.name: Table font size
parameters.description: Font size for the table in the plot

parameters.name: Image width
parameters.description: Output image width in pixels

parameters.name: Image height
parameters.description: Output image height in pixels

parameters.name: DPI
parameters.description: Dots per inch of the output image.

parameters.name: Plot filename
parameters.description: Plot output filename. When multiple comparisons are saved separately, the comparison name is appended before the file extension.
